tasks.title: Project Foundation and Monorepo Setup
tasks.description: Set up the foundational project structure using Turborepo with Bun runtime, establishing the monorepo architecture for the NSM framework development.

key_findings: Turborepo provides incremental builds and parallel execution
Bun offers 4x performance improvement over Node.js
Workspace protocols enable efficient inter-package dependencies

implementation_guidance.tdd_approach: Write project structure validation tests first, then implement monorepo configuration
test_criteria: Turborepo pipeline executes in proper order
implementation_guidance.research_references: See @.taskmaster/docs/research/2025-09-15_turborepo-monorepo.md for monorepo patterns and @.taskmaster/docs/research/2025-09-15_bun-runtime.md for runtime configuration

subtasks.title: Initialize Turborepo monorepo structure
subtasks.description: Create root package.json, turbo.json configuration, and workspace structure with proper package organization
subtasks.details: Set up workspace structure: packages/ (nsm-core, nsm-client-sdk, nsm-dev-tools), apps/ (poc-wordle, poc-whiteboard, dev-tools, docs), tools/ (shared configs)
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate workspace resolution, turbo pipeline execution, and proper dependency management

subtasks.title: Configure Bun as the primary runtime
subtasks.description: Set up Bun runtime configuration, package management, and build tools across the monorepo
subtasks.details: Configure bun.config.ts, set up package.json scripts, configure TypeScript with bun-types
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Bun build performance, runtime compatibility, and TypeScript compilation

subtasks.title: Establish shared tooling and configuration
subtasks.description: Create shared ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript configurations and development scripts
subtasks.details: Set up tools/eslint-config, tools/typescript-config, shared testing utilities
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify consistent linting and formatting across all packages

tasks.title: Core NSM Protocol Implementation
tasks.description: Implement the core Nostr State Machine protocol definitions, event schemas, and TypeScript interfaces for the three proposed event kinds (30079, 7000-7999, 10079).

key_findings: Event kind 30079 for parameterized replaceable NSM definitions
NDK provides comprehensive Nostr protocol support

implementation_guidance.tdd_approach: Write protocol validation tests first, then implement event schemas and TypeScript definitions
test_criteria: TypeScript interfaces provide full type safety

subtasks.title: Define NSM Definition Event schema (kind:30079)
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces and JSON schemas for NSM Definition Events with all required tags and content structure
subtasks.details: Define INSMDefinitionEvent interface with mandatory tags (d, name, engine, engineCodeURI) and content schema (initialState, stateSchema, interactionSchema)
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate schema against example Wordle and Whiteboard definitions

subtasks.title: Define NSM Interaction Event schema (kind:7000-7999)
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces for interaction events with proper application addressing and content validation
subtasks.details: Define INSMInteractionEvent interface with a tag addressing, content validation against interactionSchema
subtasks.testStrategy: Test interaction event validation for different application types

subtasks.title: Define NSM State Update Event schema (kind:10079)
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces for replaceable state snapshot events with state validation
subtasks.details: Define INSMStateUpdateEvent interface with proper state content validation against stateSchema
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify state snapshot validation and replaceability mechanics

subtasks.title: Implement protocol validation utilities
subtasks.description: Create validation functions for all NSM event types with comprehensive error handling and type guards
subtasks.details: Implement validateNSMDefinition, validateNSMInteraction, validateNSMStateUpdate functions with detailed error messages
subtasks.testStrategy: Test validation with malformed events, missing fields, and edge cases

tasks.title: Client SDK Development
tasks.description: Build the main NSM client SDK that wraps NDK, integrates XState, and provides a simple API for developers to build NSM applications.

key_findings: Sandboxed execution required for untrusted code

implementation_guidance.tdd_approach: Write client API tests first, then implement SDK functionality with proper error handling and security
implementation_guidance.research_references: See @.taskmaster/docs/research/2025-09-15_ndk-integration.md for NDK patterns and @.taskmaster/docs/research/2025-09-15_xstate-patterns.md for state machine integration

subtasks.title: Create NSMClient core class
subtasks.description: Implement the main client class that manages NDK instance, subscriptions, and application lifecycle
subtasks.details: Class should handle initialization, relay connections, event subscriptions, and application discovery
subtasks.testStrategy: Test client initialization, connection management, and proper cleanup

subtasks.title: Implement state machine integration with XState
subtasks.description: Create secure state machine loader and interpreter integration with sandboxed execution
subtasks.details: Implement createMachine, interpretMachine, and secure sandbox for untrusted state machine code
subtasks.testStrategy: Test state machine execution, security isolation, and performance

subtasks.title: Build application discovery and loading system

subtasks.title: Implement optimistic updates and state reconciliation
subtasks.description: Create optimistic update system with conflict resolution and canonical state synchronization

subtasks.testStrategy: Test optimistic updates, conflict resolution, and multi-user synchronization

subtasks.description: Implement event creation, signing, publishing, and real-time subscription management
